Quick Sheath.description: Lets you attack twice in one turn

Whetstone.description: Grinds a blunted edge back to biting. Raises attack by 8 for the rest of this battle.

Jolt Flask.description: Shocks the enemy: jittery actions, possible double turns, and chip damage each turn.

Caffeiene Capsule.description: Overloads the enemy with caffeiene so it attacks in a fast frenzy.

Dull Sword.description: A dull iron sword used by youth in the capital. The pommel reads 'Property of the Royal Recruits.' Grants the move: Dull Sword Slash.

Ember Shard.description: A shard of crystallized mana drawn from a Scholar's cantrip. It never quite cools. Grants the move: Cinder.

Nutcracker Blade.description: Salvaged from some unfortunate snack in the larder. Heavy, awful, and it hits like falling masonry. Grants the move: Sunder.

Scroll of Mending.description: A preserved healing cantrip. Restores 45 health.

The Scroll.description: Follow the path laid before thee, and let thy steps carry thee onward, for within the kingdom there awaiteth peace and prosperity.
pages: Follow the path laid before thee, and let thy steps carry thee onward, for within the kingdom there lies the hope of peace and prosperity.
The way shall lead thee beneath the roots of the world, where the deep caverns keep the old road in shadow. Tread lightly, and heed the stones that speak without a voice.
When thou hast escaped the darkness below, turn thy face toward the peak beneath the midnight moon. There the one who remains shall await thy coming.
Speak with him, and the realm may yet know a true knight once more. Let neither fear nor doubt turn thee from thy path, child of the academy.
